title: MALAMUTE: A Multilingual, Highly-granular, Template-free, Education-based Probing Dataset

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model accuracy on parallel cloze-style probing tasks and generative prompts across English, Spanish, and Polish to identify performance disparities that could exacerbate educational inequalities for non-English speakers.

Analyzing knowledge retrieval accuracy across 8 broad educational domains and 55 fine-grained academic subdomains to identify uneven knowledge distribution, subject-specific vulnerabilities, and gaps in model proficiency.

Measuring the sensitivity and variation in model performance by evaluating prediction accuracy across three distinct prompt designs (including zero-shot and few-shot) and comparing sentence-level versus paragraph-level contextual formulations.
